pages.title: A Question Under the Moon
pages.content:
It is a Ramadan night. Yusuf is in the garden with his grandpa. They drink tea. There is a big moon in the sky. There are many bright stars, too. Yusuf looks up. He has got a question. “Grandpa, who are the first people on Earth?” he asks. Grandpa smiles. He has got a nice story for Yusuf.

“Listen, Yusuf,” Grandpa says. “At first, there are no people on Earth. Allah makes the sky and the earth. The sky is blue, and the earth is green. Then, Allah talks to the angels. He says, ‘There is a new man for the earth.’ The angels are surprised! They ask, ‘Who is this new man?’”

vocabulary.definition: The month of fasting for Muslims.
The big, round light in the night sky.
Our world. We live on it.

pages.title: The First Man
pages.content:
Yusuf’s eyes are big and bright. “Then what happens, Grandpa?” he asks.

Grandpa looks at him and says, “The angels take some soil from the Earth. Allah makes the first man from it. His name is Adam. Adam is the father of all people. We are all his children.

“Allah teaches Adam the names of many things. Adam has got a lot of knowledge now! He knows trees, birds, and stars. The angels like Adam very much. Allah says, ‘Be nice to Adam!’ All the angels listen. But Iblis does not! He says, ‘I am from fire, and Adam is from soil. I am better than him!’ Iblis is wrong, and he is not sorry. So, Allah tells him, ‘Leave this place!’”

Yusuf listens carefully. “Iblis does not listen to Allah. He is not good, Grandpa,” he says.

vocabulary.definition: The things you know and learn.

pages.title: A Garden in Paradise
pages.content:
Grandpa says, “Yes, Yusuf. Iblis does not like Adam at all. Allah tells Adam, ‘Be careful! Iblis is not your friend.’

“Adam lives in Paradise. It is a very beautiful garden! There are nice trees and flowers everywhere. But Adam hasn’t got a friend. So, Allah gives him a wife. Her name is Hawwa. Now, Adam is very happy! Everything in Paradise is for them. Allah tells them only one thing: ‘Do not go near this tree.’”

iCan: I can say: Adam and Hawwa live in Paradise.

pages.title: A Big Lie
pages.content:
Yusuf has got many questions! Grandpa goes on.

“One day, Iblis comes to Adam and Hawwa. He tells a big lie. He says, ‘I am your friend! Eat from that tree.’

“Adam and Hawwa forget Allah’s words. They eat from the tree. Now, they are very sad. It is a mistake!

“Adam and Hawwa say sorry to Allah. Allah hears them. He says, ‘Do not be sad. I am kind to you.’ Iblis is very different. He never says sorry. He says, ‘I am right!’”

pages.title: Life on Earth
pages.content:
“Then, Allah sends Adam and Hawwa to the Earth. He makes Adam His first messenger.

“They live there. They have got animals and plants. They work. They grow food. Life is not easy. Adam helps Hawwa. Hawwa helps Adam.

“Allah takes Iblis out of Paradise. He comes down to Earth, too.”

Yusuf looks at Grandpa. “Have Adam and Hawwa got children?” he asks.

Grandpa smiles. “Yes, Yusuf,” he says. “Adam and Hawwa have got two sons. Their names are Habil and Qabil. Habil is very nice. He has got sheep and cows. Qabil has got a farm. He grows fruits and plants. But Qabil does not like his brother. Adam always says to his children, ‘Be good! Do not forget Allah!’”

vocabulary.definition: A person who brings Allah’s words to people.

pages.title: Two Brothers
pages.content:
“One day, Qabil is very angry. He shouts at Habil. Habil is calm. He says, ‘I do not fight you. You are my brother. I love Allah!’

“Habil is a nice boy. He is not bad to his brother. Qabil makes a very big mistake. He is very sad later.”

Grandpa drinks his tea. “Habil is a very good boy, Yusuf,” he says. “Be kind to your brothers and friends. Allah loves kind people.”

Yusuf smiles. “Habil is my hero, Grandpa!” he says. It is late now. Grandpa says, “Good night, Yusuf! It is a long story. Now, go to your bed, my boy!” Yusuf hugs his grandpa. He goes to bed with a big smile.

vocabulary.definition: Puts his arms around someone with love.
